title: Chhota Bheem: Krishna vs Zimbara
original_title: छोटा भीम और कृष्णा बनाम ज़िम्बारा
overview: A demon of darkness is plotting world domination — but when Bheem and Krishna catch wind of his plans, they’ll stop at nothing to destroy him.

songs.title: Chhota Bheem & Krishna vs Zimbara
songs.singers: Chhota Bheem, Krishna The Great, Sudesh Bhosle, Oushnik Majumdar
